::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 22d 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 46-47
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Many thanks for [the payment](organizations/other_160.qmd) which comes pleasantly early this year.

My [Spaniards and Moors](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) are progressing, but I suppose I had better finish all before I send them, as if abridgement is needful it is better done on a whole than on a part.  

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
